task: F2 Unity request-70 socket resource-safety re-audit
originalIntent: Provide a bounded direct request-70 socket that preserves legacy request behavior, cannot be exhausted by queued or in-flight clients, times out/cancels safely, rejects malformed or oversized protocol data, and never hangs Unity.
desiredOutcome: A request-70 peer may fail or disconnect without blocking Unity's main thread or leaking socket capacity/resources; teardown owns all accepted clients.

findings.violatedCriterion: F2-SOCKET-RESOURCE-SAFETY: request-70 clients must not hang Unity and socket I/O must be timeout/cancellation bounded
findings.observation: Serve performs synchronous NetworkStream.Write for both failure and up-to-64-MiB success responses on the Unity coroutine/main thread with no SendTimeout, asynchronous yield, cancellation, or bounded write loop. A client can send byte 70 and stop reading, filling the TCP buffer and blocking the frame loop indefinitely.

findings.violatedCriterion: F2-SOCKET-RESOURCE-SAFETY: cancellation/destruction must close and release every accepted client
findings.observation: After Update dequeues a client, it is no longer present in the only tracked collection. OnDestroy stops the listener and closes queued clients only; it has no in-flight registry or cancellation path. Destruction/interruption therefore does not deterministically close already-serving sockets or release their reservation through the iterator finally block.

confirmedControls.queueAndInflightCap: MaxPendingClients=4 and reservedClientCount is incremented before enqueue and decremented in Serve finally/queued teardown; overflow clients are closed.
confirmedControls.silentRequestTimeout: A pre-request client is polled without blocking and abandoned after 1000 ms.
confirmedControls.oversizedEnvelope: Unity preflights PNG, JSON, failure-message, combined payload and envelope sizes; Python decoder rejects declared overflows.
confirmedControls.malformedDecoder: Python malformed-envelope suite rejects bad magic/version/length/JSON/flags/failure length/render-frame/PNG and overflow.
confirmedControls.bridgeTimeout: Python bridge sets a socket timeout at connect and disconnects on protocol errors. This does not bound the Unity server's synchronous send.
